description: The language a voice is routed for when text is spoken (spec #100 slice 2.5, ticket #160): a caller-supplied language wins as it is, never lowercased, validated or re-checked (spokenReply's decision, the English of app announcements, the Settings voice sample's own language), so an appended phrase or a too-short string cannot flip the voice; with none, the decision of language.json, and "en" when that is undecided. Which voice serves the language stays with the platform.
function: TTSService.voiceLanguage(for:language:) — input {text, language} with language a string or null, expected the language
